timing_defs.onset_t: first sample above -30 dB re file peak (s)
timing_defs.peak_t: time of max 15 ms RMS (s) - the hit/cut point
timing_defs.attack_ms: onset_t to first 15 ms-RMS frame within 3 dB of max
timing_defs.tail_t: last 15 ms-RMS frame above -40 dB re max
timing_defs.cleanliness: 0-100 from noise floor in quiet parts (10th pct of 15 ms RMS, dB re max); beds score low by nature
